title: Canonical pullback comparisons and tower orientation base change
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, ell unequal to its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_ell, and a Cartesian square of separated finite-type D.k-schemes with noetherian total spaces and f smooth separated of pure dimension d. Supply tower coordinates b,o,q, a compactification c, the two restricted adjunctions and calibrated finite-level data a, compact-support exchange x with beta invertible, and published purity packages P,Pprime at c and its pulled-back compactification [def-sp-purity-bc-tower-data]. Supply normalized geometric pullback coordinates gu,gv at each positive quotient. There exist isomorphisms s:v*unit_Y to unit_Yprime and t:u*orderedLine_X(d) to orderedLine_Xprime(d). At every quotient s satisfies the specified ordinary constant-unit pullback WordComparison, and t satisfies the specified Kummer/integration coefficient-line pullback WordComparison. Moreover u*(P.orientation) followed by towerUnitExchange(s) equals t followed by Pprime.orientation. No tensor-mate or gamma base-change equation is asserted.

source.place: Proof (1), tower orientation factor and the specified source comparisons

proof.text: Construct the coefficient-unit pullback map and the ordered Tate-line pullback map as maps of strict sheaf towers. The normalized Kummer/constant-section maps commute with quotient transitions and give their inverses. Exact evaluation and the ordered tensor conventions yield the two stated WordComparison equations.

Transport an arbitrary Cartesian square to the chosen fiber product. Extract the normalized finite orientations from P.finite_levels and Pprime.finite_levels. Apply finite_orientation_base_change at A=O_E/ell^(n+1). The mate evaluation/reduction theorem identifies the evaluated exceptional map, including unit realization counits. Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies arbitrary supplied adjunctions with those of the mate-evaluation theorem, preserving their counits and hence their transposes.

Conjugate the proposed orientation equation by the actual orientations. Both endpoints are equally shifted rank-one sheaf towers; apply tower_orientation_transport and its shifted-heart injectivity to the finite equations. Reinsert the fixed realization counits and the unit comparison. This gives the displayed orientation equation without testing equality of arbitrary derived maps.

theorem tower_factor_orientation
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hne : ell ≠ D.p)
    (X Y X' Y' : Over (Spec (.of D.k)))
    [IsSeparated X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    [IsSeparated X'.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X'.hom] [QuasiCompact X'.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y'.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y'.hom] [QuasiCompact Y'.hom]
    [IsNoetherian X.left] [IsNoetherian Y.left]
    [IsNoetherian X'.left] [IsNoetherian Y'.left]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (v : Y' ⟶ Y) (u' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (sq : IsPullback u'.left f'.left f.left v.left)
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f.left]
    [IsSeparated f.left] [QuasiCompact f.left] [HasCompactification f.left]
    [QuasiCompact f'.left] [HasCompactification f'.left]
    (c : Compactification f.left) (a : SpTowerMate.Data ell E b o q sq c)
    (x : SpTowerShriek.OpenExchange ell E b o)
    (hb : IsIso (SpTowerMate.beta ell E b o q a x))
    (w : SpChartAdmissibility.Twists ell E X.left)
    (w' : SpChartAdmissibility.Twists ell E X'.left)
    (P : TowerPurityAt ell E b o q c d w a.support_closed a.right
      a.adjunction a.levels)
    (P' : TowerPurityAt ell E b o q (c.ofIsPullback sq) d w' a.support_closed'
      a.right' a.adjunction' a.levels')
    (gu : ∀ n : ℕ, SpTowerP1.GeometricCoordinates ell E n u'.left)
    (gv : ∀ n : ℕ, SpTowerP1.GeometricCoordinates ell E n v.left) :
    ∃ (s : (SpTowerShriek.pull ell E b (o.geometry v.left)).obj
        (SpTowerGamma.unit ell E Y.left) ≅ SpTowerGamma.unit ell E Y'.left)
      (t : (SpTowerShriek.pull ell E b (o.geometry u'.left)).obj
        (SpTowerGamma.orderedLine ell E b X.left w d) ≅
          SpTowerGamma.orderedLine ell E b X'.left w' d),
      (∀ n : ℕ, SpTowerP1.WordComparison ell E n
        (SpTowerP1.pullWord ell E n b (o.geometry v.left) (gv n)
          (SpTowerP1.unitWord ell E n Y.left (P.coefficientsY n)))
        (SpTowerP1.unitWord ell E n Y'.left (P'.coefficientsY n)) s.hom
        (((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback (SpTowerP1.levelRing ell E n) v.left).mapIso
          (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (SpTowerP1.levelRing ell E n)) Y.left) ≪≫
          Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (SpTowerP1.levelRing ell E n)) v.left ≪≫
          (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (SpTowerP1.levelRing ell E n)) Y'.left).symm).hom)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, SpTowerP1.WordComparison ell E n
        (SpTowerP1.pullWord ell E n b (o.geometry u'.left) (gu n)
          (SpTowerGamma.coefficientWord ell E b X.left w P.roots n
            (P.unitsX n) (P.coefficientsX n) (P.tensors n) d))
        (SpTowerGamma.coefficientWord ell E b X'.left w' P'.roots n
          (P'.unitsX n) (P'.coefficientsX n) (P'.tensors n) d) t.hom
        ((Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback (SpTowerP1.levelRing ell E n)
          (ell ^ (n + 1)) (SpTowerP1.levelAnnihilates ell E n)
          (PurityFiniteSetting.purityTwistTransport (SpTowerP1.levelRing ell E n)
            (ell ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : ell.Prime).pos _)
            (SpTowerP1.levelAnnihilates ell E n)) u'.left (P.unitsX n) d).hom)) ∧
      (SpTowerShriek.pull ell E b (o.geometry u'.left)).map P.orientation.hom ≫
          towerUnitExchange ell E b o q a x hb P.unit_mem P'.unit_mem s =
        t.hom ≫ P'.orientation.hom
